request.query: Weighted order of vanishing is at least a threshold iff all lower weight Taylor coefficients vanish; derivatives above a coordinate degree vanish.

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: MvPowerSeries.nat_le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_order
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑(Finsupp.degree d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ f.order

items.name: MvPowerSeries.nat_le_order
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ f.order

items.name: natCast_le_analyticOrderAt_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {n : ℕ} {z₀ : 𝕜} [CharZero 𝕜] [CompleteSpace E],
  AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀ → (↑n ≤ analyticOrderAt f z₀ ↔ ∀ i < n, iteratedDeriv i f z₀ = 0)
